name: llama3.1-instruct-lab_bench-r1
description: A community-contributed evaluation suite for instruction-following LLaMA-style models measuring capabilities across diverse prompt types. It includes question answering, summarization, simple code tasks, and other instruction-following probes to assess alignment and practical usefulness.
reputation: User-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited public adoption, mainly used for model-specific fine-tuning and evaluation.
